name: Should I hire a professional contractor to replace my faucets?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a professional contractor to replace my faucets?

acceptedAnswer.text: While DIY faucet installation is possible for minor swaps, hiring a licensed contractor is recommended when faucet updates are part of a broader bathroom or kitchen remodel. Professional installation ensures shutoff valves meet plumbing standards, supply lines are secured without dangerous over-tightening, and countertop cutouts are properly sealed against water penetration. Furthermore, if your remodel involves relocating the sink, reconfiguring cabinet layouts, or running new supply lines, general contracting coordination guarantees all rough plumbing is properly inspected and compliant.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a licensed professional ensures secure supply lines, proper watertight sealing, and seamless coordination with broader countertop and cabinetry remodeling work.
